description: Read one interview knowledge base: name, the start of its text with total length, and an overview of its Q&A entries (one per line). The ID comes from list_knowledge_bases. Pass contentOffset to read long text 4000 characters at a time, or entryIds for full Q&A entries. (Requires the user's sign-in with scope interviews:read.)
